sentences.en: I wanted to congratulate you, albeit belatedly, on passing your exam.
sentences.zh: 我虽然迟了一些，还是想祝贺你通过了考试。

sentences.en: Have you ever eaten javelina? It's quite good, albeit somewhat gamy.
sentences.zh: 你吃过豪猪吗？味道不错，尽管带点野味的味道。

sentences.en: Many software companies offer free versions of their products, albeit with limited functionality.
sentences.zh: 许多软件公司提供功能受限的免费版本。
